name: Hoppy Cat: February Third

choices.subject: hoppycat-hoppy-cat
choices.label: Share the Halfway Cup
choices.text: Hoppy Cat shares the welcome table. Tapi leaves a chair for the next guest. The cup holds a promise to hear each person through.

choices.subject: hoppycat-penny-vellum
choices.label: Keep the correction beside the story
choices.text: Penny marks the changed line and its source on the card. The public exhibit keeps both the first account and its correction.

choices.subject: hoppycat-patch-fern
choices.label: Plant one useful memory
choices.text: Patch plants the seed in a labelled bed. Its label says why this memory matters and where a later correction can be added.

choices.subject: hoppycat-lumen-facet
choices.label: Choose your own final facet
choices.text: Lumen holds the prism steady while its carrier chooses the final facet. Phase Two leaves room in the plan for that choice.

choices.subject: hoppycat-rill-current
choices.label: Trace a reflection to its source
choices.text: Rill and Arc trace each pool back to the light that reached it. The compass marks a clear route home.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: Give Nix time to hear the bell plan
choices.text: Nix asks for a quiet pause. The visitors sit beside the wheel until the bat lowers one wing and invites them to continue.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: Tie the chosen thread to the wheel
choices.text: Nix holds the wheel while the carrier ties the red thread. The knot keeps the record, memory, facet, and route together.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: Fit the clapper and welcome February Third
choices.text: With Nix ready, the carrier fits the clapper. The bell sounds once. The garden calendar turns to February Third, and everyone has a tomorrow to shape.

choices.subject: hoppycat-mira-meraki
choices.label: Paint a playbill with Mira
choices.text: Mira adds a bright, uneven border with the five-tipped brush. The playbill leaves space for each maker and for the next draft.

choices.subject: hoppycat-solwashere
choices.label: Give each performer a line of credit
choices.text: Sol reads the playbill: Hoppy, Arc, Fable, Phase Two, Static, Sol, both Ledgers, and Piper on flute and drums. The display credits the public Not Affiliated band; tonight's forest scene is a new story.

choices.subject: hoppycat-solwashere
choices.label: Stage the shared evening
choices.text: The disco ball turns above a new forest play. Each contributor has a credit, each prop has a source, and the audience keeps an open chair for the next arrival.

choices.subject: hoppycat-glim-twice
choices.label: Try the dream a second time
choices.text: Glim rolls the loop token around its brass track. The first attempt stays in the notebook; the second gets a fresh page.

choices.subject: hoppycat-staticwashere
choices.label: Write the source and the way home
choices.text: Static checks the launch card through the Observatory telescope. The source, open question, permission, and return route each get a line.

choices.subject: hoppycat-staticwashere
choices.label: Send the invitation for tomorrow
choices.text: A small paper boat carries an invitation to tomorrow's show. Its card names the makers and the route back to the garden. Static watches until the lantern reaches the next shore.
